body:
## Pull request overview

Refactors the console’s system settings management pages to use the metadata-driven `ObjectView` (`@object-ui/plugin-view`) instead of hand-built tables and bespoke CRUD/fetch logic, leveraging `systemObjects.ts` as the source of truth.

**Changes:**
- Added a shared `SystemObjectViewPage` wrapper that builds an `ObjectViewSchema` from `systemObjects.ts` and renders `ObjectView` with the adapter `dataSource`.
- Migrated Users/Orgs/Roles/Permissions/Audit Log pages to delegate rendering + CRUD gating to `SystemObjectViewPage`.
- Updated system page tests to mock `ObjectView` and assert schema configuration; updated ROADMAP/CHANGELOG accordingly.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |

| apps/console/src/pages/system/UserManagementPage.tsx | Simplified to delegate to `SystemObjectViewPage` for `sys_user`. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/OrgManagementPage.tsx | Simplified to delegate to `SystemObjectViewPage` for `sys_org`. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/RoleManagementPage.tsx | Simplified to delegate to `SystemObjectViewPage` for `sys_role`. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/PermissionManagementPage.tsx | Simplified to delegate to `SystemObjectViewPage` for `sys_permission`. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx | Simplified to delegate to `SystemObjectViewPage` for `sys_audit_log` in read-only mode. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/SystemPages.test.tsx | Tests updated to mock `@object-ui/plugin-view` and assert `ObjectView` schema + dataSource wiring. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents completion of “ObjectView-Driven System Pages”. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Notes the system pages refactor to ObjectView. |
</details>

`ObjectView` is not rendered while `dataSource` is null. Since `AdapterProvider` initializes the adapter asynchronously, this can leave the page showing only the header (no loading/empty/error state) during initial load or reconnects. Consider rendering a loading indicator or a fallback message when `dataSource` is null (and/or disabling the page until the adapter is ready). ```suggestion {!dataSource ? (
Preparing data connection. Please wait...
) : ( ```

The previous AuditLog page explicitly fetched with `$orderby: { createdAt: 'desc' }` (newest-first). The new schema does not set any default sort, so audit entries may render in an arbitrary/oldest-first order depending on backend defaults. Add a default sort for audit logs (e.g., via `schema.table.defaultSort` / view metadata) so the audit log remains chronological by default.
